reasoning: OpenShell is a sandboxed runtime platform/service for autonomous AI agents. It provides a gateway server (openshell-server) that manages sandbox lifecycle via gRPC APIs, a CLI (openshell-cli) for user interaction, a supervisor runtime for policy enforcement and networking, and multiple compute driver backends (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, VM, Windows MXC). It also ships SDKs in Rust, Python, TypeScript, and Go, plus Helm charts for Kubernetes deployment. The project is a full service stack — not an operator (no Kubernetes CRD controllers), not a library (it's a deployable application with server, CLI, and runtime components), and not configuration-only.
